_comment: Copy this file to rules_config.json and edit it - that copy is yours, not shared or overwritten by updates. Each key is an app's .exe filename. A plain "english"/"hebrew" value applies to that app always. An object value lets different windows/tabs of the same app (matched by a keyword anywhere in the window title) use different languages - the first matching keyword wins. CKILS still works fine with an empty file ({}) - the trained content-aware model handles everything except a field with nothing typed into it yet.
